changes.title: Audio latency
items: The sound gets a little more breathing room, so it should cut out less
The playtest log (L) now says why the sound cut out: the device fell behind, its clock stepped, or the game went quiet

changes.title: Min hostile
items: Every wild area now has at least one young or grown-up animal in it, even the gentle ones near home.

changes.title: Wild left
items: Land in a wild area and, once they've had their look at you, all its young and grown-up animals come after you while you're in their area, until you invite them or get knocked out. Invite them all and its runestone turns into a soundsystem.

In a wild area, a line under the clock says how many of its wild animals are still to invite (and how many are asleep or knocked down), and the last three get pointers, so you can find the ones out of sight and turn its runestone.
